description: Jet 4 MDB: 6xzx open edge — db1 & db2 open RW (Phase 1 same WS, Phase 2 two WS); db2 holds TableDefs('U') (tdU), tdU.Fields (flsU), Field('V') (fV), and tdU.Indexes (ixsU). db1 runs DROP TABLE U; probes every held wrapper call (Name, RecordCount, Attributes, DateCreated, LastUpdated, Fields.Count, fV.Name/Type, Indexes.Count, OpenRecordset, CreateField+Append, fresh tds2.Item('U')) BEFORE and AFTER tds2.Refresh(). Keeps all pages at every boundary.
